project_type: Flask web application with SQLite database, plain HTML/CSS/JS frontend
build_system: No build step required - Python Flask runs directly
test_framework: No test framework currently in project
test_command: Manual testing via http://127.0.0.1:5000 with demo logins: admin@reliefgrid.org/admin123 (admin) and riverside@ngo.org/relief123 (relief center user)
verification_instructions: 1. Delete reliefgrid.db to reset. 2. Run python app.py. 3. Login as admin and relief users. 4. Test allocation flow: submit requests, run allocation, check deliveries. 5. Verify database schema changes with sqlite3 reliefgrid.db '.schema requests'
snapshot_or_generated_files: reliefgrid.db is generated on first run from db.py schema and seed data. Should be deleted for clean testing.
environment_constraints: SQLite only, Flask only. No external services. SECRET_KEY should be set in environment for production but defaults to 'dev-only-change-me' for local demos.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md or AGENTS.md found. Follow existing code style: 2-space indent in templates, 4-space in Python. Keep UI consistent with existing style.css classes.
key_patterns: Routes grouped by module in app.py. Helper functions defined before routes. Template inheritance from base.html. Macros in _macros.html for pills and stats. Status progression through db updates with notifications to users. Stock calculations use available_stock() which subtracts reserved deliveries. Priority scoring: 45% urgency + 30% severity + 25% people affected.
relevant_files: db.py - schema definition, init_db(), seed() - ADD new fields to requests table here
app.py - all Flask routes, finalize_request() updates request status, available_stock() calculates unreserved stock
allocation.py - allocate() function takes requests list and stock dict, returns results with allocated/unmet quantities
templates/admin_dashboard.html - main admin overview with stats cards and map
templates/admin_requests.html - request table with filters by status, inline decision forms
templates/allocations.html - allocation preview/apply with score explanation
templates/my_requests.html - relief user view of their requests
static/style.css - all styling, pill colors, card layouts, responsive grid
directory_structure: Root: app.py (routes), db.py (schema), allocation.py (algorithm), requirements.txt. Subdirs: templates/ (Jinja2 HTML), static/ (style.css). Database: reliefgrid.db (generated, should be in .gitignore)
